title: Read a CSV table and aggregate one column
prompt:
Here is a CSV table of tasks.

id,team,status,hours
T-01,infra,done,3.5
T-02,docs,open,2
T-03,infra,open,8
T-04,evals,done,5.25
T-05,docs,done,1
T-06,infra,done,4
T-07,evals,open,6
T-08,infra,blocked,2.5
T-09,docs,open,0.75
T-10,infra,open,7
T-11,evals,done,3
T-12,infra,done,1.5

What is the total of `hours` for tasks whose team is infra and whose status is not done? Reply with the number only.
